description: Header definitions for mDNS client implementation, including classes for socket factory, connection, listener, and transaction handling within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: MDnsSocketFactoryImpl
classes.description: Implements socket creation for mDNS using provided NetLog.

classes.name: MDnsConnection
classes.description: Manages network connection for multicast DNS, handles socket communication, and delegates packet handling.

classes.name: MDnsClientImpl
classes.description: Main implementation of MDnsClient, manages listeners, cache, and network connection.

classes.name: MDnsListenerImpl
classes.description: Implements MDnsListener, manages active listening and record refreshes.

classes.name: MDnsTransactionImpl
classes.description: Handles DNS transaction lifecycle, including sending queries and processing responses.

methods.name: CreateSockets
methods.description: Creates and initializes sockets for mDNS communication.

methods.name: HandlePacket
methods.description: Processes incoming DNS responses and updates cache/listeners.

methods.name: SendQuery
methods.description: Sends a DNS query with specified type and name.

methods.name: SetActiveRefresh
methods.description: Enables or disables active refresh of records.

methods.name: HandleRecordUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to DNS records and notifies delegate.

methods.name: QueryAndListen
methods.description: Sends a query and sets up listening with timeout.
